text: A cleanup on 17 September reclaimed 484 GB (free 1.7 T to 2.2 T): every toy set (rebuild is under a second each), the 2.46 M cloud-search-real and loss-decomp-real sets, and 145 GB of tmp-claude. Kept: recall-real, the cutoffs-real draw, and the four cutoffs-sp-* sets with their runs and analyses.
